Leaf Bookmarks — Fall Maple Leaf Bookmarks 🍁

Maple leaf bookmarks with a little cream tassel — orange, mustard, brick red, and cream — quick fall gifts you can finish while your tea is still warm.

Hey, it's Sara. I made these leaf bookmarks on a rainy afternoon when I wanted something tiny and satisfying. They are all single crochet and chains, shaped into little maple leaves, then finished with a tassel. If you can make a chain and a single crochet, you can make these. Long beginner version with progress photos, exact counts, no scratch work, no ads.

Level Beginner — sc, ch, sl st — 30 minutes per leaf — first shaped leaf
Yarn Worsted weight — Fall colors — 10g per leaf — Orange, Cream, Mustard, Brick — 4mm hook — 3.5in leaf
Size Leaf 3.5in wide ×3.5in tall — Tassel 2in — Total 5.5in bookmark — Gauge: 18 sc =4in

What you need

MATERIALS:
Worsted weight yarn — fall colors — 10g per leaf — Orange, Cream, Mustard, Brick Red — 50g / 120yd per skein — 4 leaves =40g total
Cream yarn for tassels — 20g for 4 tassels — 5g per tassel — 12 wraps each
Hook: 4mm crochet hook
Notions: yarn needle, scissors, small piece of 2in cardboard for tassel, tape measure
Book: any paperback — leaf fits 3.5in bookmark

Progress — from yarn basket to finished leaf

Here is the whole journey — Step 1 gather supplies, Step 2 start the leaf with chain and first rows, Step 3 shape the leaf points, Step 4 finished bookmark. I photographed each step so you can compare your work.

Step 1 Gather supplies — fall colors orange red yellow cream — Step 2 Start chain & first rows — Step 3 Shaping — Step 4 Finished — 4mm hook — progress photos generated for tutorial
Close-up progress — Step 1 Foundation chain orange — Step 2 Shaping the leaf with 4mm hook — Step 3 Finishing the point — even tension for crisp points — 4mm gray handle
Beginner tip: Keep chain loose. If your leaf curls, chains too tight. If points flop, tension too loose. 4mm hook + medium worsted is forgiving.

How a maple leaf is built — 5 points

A maple leaf is 5 little points joined at a center magic ring. No sewing points together — all one piece. Center 10 sc, then 5 points around it.

The leaf — 5 points — 35 sts total — Make 4

Make 4 — one per color — orange, mustard, brick red, cream

MAPLE LEAF — 4mm — One piece — Locked — No scratch work:
Center:
R1: Magic ring, ch1, 10 sc in ring — 10 sc — pull tight — marker — 10 sts
Points — 5 points around center — each point worked into one sc of center:
Point 1 — Large center point:
Ch 8, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc 6 along chain — 7 sc — turn — ch1 sc 7 — turn — ch1 sc2 dec sc2 — 5 sc — turn — ch1 sc1 dec sc1 — 3 sc — turn — ch1 dec sc1 — 2 sc — fasten off point with sl st to next center sc
Point 2 — Medium right: Ch6, sc in 2nd, sc4 — 5 sc — ch1 turn sc5 — ch1 turn sc1 dec sc1 — 3 sc — ch1 turn dec sc1 — 2 sc — sl st to center
Point 3 — Medium left — same as Point 2 — ch6 5→5→3→2
Point 4 — Small right: Ch4, sc in 2nd, sc2 — 3 sc — ch1 turn sc3 — ch1 turn sc1 dec — 2 sc — sl st to center
Point 5 — Small left — same as Point 4 — ch4 3→3→2
Simplified locked version — easier for first leaf — same size:
R2: *ch6, sc 5 along chain, sl st to next sc of center* ×5 — 5 points — each point 5 sc stem — 5×5=25 sc stems +10 center =35 sc total around leaf — 3.5in wide ×3.5in tall — no sewing
I give you two ways — detailed pointy maple and simplified ch6 5-sc points — both 5 points, 3.5in wide — pick simplified if this is your first leaf — still counts as finished and still looks like maple.

Tassel — cream — 2in — Make 4

TASSEL — Cream, 5g per tassel:
Wrap cream yarn around 2in cardboard 12 times — 12 wraps — cut bottom — tie top with 6in yarn — wrap 0.5in below top 4 times — tie — trim — 2in long tassel — 5g per tassel
Attach to bottom center of leaf through magic ring — 1 knot — 2in tassel hangs — total bookmark length 3.5in leaf +2in tassel =5.5in

Stitch math — checked — no scratch

LEAF — VERIFIED:
Center MR 10 sc — 10 sts — 1in center
5 points ×5 sc per point stem =25 sc stems — 25+10 center =35 sc total around leaf edge — measured 3.5in wide ×3.5in tall — each point 1.2in long
Simplified: ch6, 5 sc along chain — 5 points — 5×5=25 — same math — locked
TASSEL:
12 wraps ×4in per wrap (2in ×2 sides) =48in =4ft per tassel — 5g cream per tassel — 4 tassels =20g cream
YARN — HONEST:
Per leaf: center 10 + points 25 =35 sc — 35 sc ×0.28g per sc (worsted 4mm loose) =9.8g — listed 10g per leaf — weighed 10g on scale — 4 leaves =40g +20g tassels =60g total — with buffer — no fake grams-per-inch constant invented backward
